description: Grant or revoke individual user access to an MCP server, and/or set the server default (default_user_access) for users without an override. Changes take effect immediately and override the default access setting for the selected users; use list_mcp_server_user_access first if you need the current state.

default_user_access.description: Server default for users without an explicit override. Provide this, users, or both

id.description: The MCP server ID or slug

name: update_mcp_server_user_access
